description: Neutral wording for operation journal records, shared by every client. Each label states what the host recorded and nothing more: a Completed state is not a visible picture, and only outcomes whose code says the owner confirmed visibility use the word visible. A client shows the raw code (sanitised, truncated) for any kind, outcome or state it does not know.

outcomes.method_returned: Steam returned from the call; the physical result is not confirmed
outcomes.mode_request_returned: Mode request returned; waiting for confirmation
outcomes.target_active_read_back: Selected screen read back as active; waiting for confirmation
outcomes.target_active_reconciled_after_reload: Selected screen read back as active after a plugin reload
outcomes.visible_picture_confirmed: Owner confirmed the picture was visible
outcomes.active_screen_visible_and_confirmed: Owner confirmed the selected screen was visible
outcomes.current_mode_visible_and_read_back: Current mode read back; owner confirmed the picture was visible
outcomes.restored_and_read_back: Previous mode restored and read back
outcomes.gamescope_output_configured: Gamescope output saved; applies after Gaming Mode restarts
outcomes.gamescope_output_configured_and_restart_: Gamescope output saved; Gaming Mode restart requested
outcomes.gamescope_output_configured_restart_fail: Gamescope output saved; Gaming Mode restart failed
